risefix3: Nineteen agents. Two managers. And five behind them: three in support, the branch manager's assistant, and our driver. Not one of them has left.

Eighty-seven agents have come through this branch in the sixteen years the record covers. Fifty-one resigned. Four retired out of it. Three left vested. Two transferred inside Guardian. And in all that time, two were terminated.

When this company launched its first digital application, with a digital signature on it, this branch led the team that built it. So we didn't go digital this year. Our first digital submission was filed in two thousand and eleven.
We don't do AI for the sake of it. We use it to make what we already had far more robust.

A hundred and forty-four fact finds this year, sixty-three already through a manager, and one in five came back for more work. The training runs every week, and agents who started this on paper are turning out full recommendations now.

Here's the part nobody talks about: all of this protects you. Market conduct, clause by clause, and our fact find answers every one. Fraud is rising across this industry. Early detection is the job of a proper fact find, and the surveys told us why people pushed back.
Production, goals, pendings, the transmittal — live on the walls in here all day, and on the wall outside where everybody walks past. What's done, what's late, and whose name is on it.

And there is a way up from here. Agent. Executive Agent. Trainee Manager. Unit Manager. This branch grows its own. And the three-year plan runs to September twenty twenty-nine: rebuild the bench, grow the units, forty agents.
Friday, twelve noon, ninety minutes. Seventy-five of them belong to you, not to me.
